run_interactive_translation: run fairseq interactive translation on raw text input using a trained model with on-the-fly batching
run_buffered_read: run buffered_read to read lines from a file in configurable buffer-sized chunks for batched processing
run_make_batches: run make_batches to encode input lines and yield Batch namedtuples with tokens, lengths, and constraints
run_main_generation: run the main generation loop that loads models, builds a generator, and translates input sentences interactively
run_cli_main: run cli_main to parse interactive generation arguments and start the fairseq translation pipeline via distributed_utils
